name: Wei Zhao
bio:
Wei's passion for motorsport ignited during his university years, where he was heavily involved in the Formula SAE team at the National University of Singapore. After graduating with a degree in Marketing, he focused on internships at several local racing teams, assisting with social media campaigns and event promotion. His energy and enthusiasm are contagious, and he's driven to apply cutting-edge strategies to boost brand visibility and fan engagement. 

Wei believes that innovative storytelling is key to connecting with audiences in the digital age. He's adept at leveraging data analytics to refine marketing tactics and maximize ROI. Wei is known for pushing boundaries, unafraid to experiment with new platforms and approaches to reach a wider demographic. He is a driven individual eager to make his mark on the motorsport world.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly-combed with a slight fade on the sides.
physical.description: Wei is of average height with a lean build.

quirks: Always arrives precisely 15 minutes early to meetings.
Obsessively organizes his desk, color-coding everything.
Secretly live-streams sim racing in his spare time.
